flatten_object_for_tracing: use flatten_to_tuple to flatten a dict or Instances object into a tuple of tensors for PyTorch tracing
rebuild_from_flattened: use a Schema object's call method to rebuild the original object from flattened tensor outputs
trace_model_with_adapter: create a TracingAdapter wrapping a model and its inputs to make the model traceable with torch.jit.trace
wrap_traced_model: use TracingAdapter._create_wrapper to wrap a traced model so it accepts and returns the original input output format
flatten_instances_schema: use InstancesSchema to flatten and rebuild detectron2 Instances objects containing image size and detection fields
